a habitual offender: The police recognized the man at once because he was a habitual offender who had been arrested for stealing many times.
警方一眼就認出那名男子，因為他是多次因偷竊被捕的慣犯。
habitual lateness: Because of his habitual lateness, Tom missed the first ten minutes of class almost every morning.
因為習慣性遲到，湯姆幾乎每天早上都錯過第一節課的前十分鐘。
a habitual liar: Nobody believed Kevin's story about the lost wallet, since everyone knew he was a habitual liar.
沒有人相信凱文弄丟錢包的說法，因為大家都知道他是個慣性說謊者。
one's habitual seat: Grandpa sat down in his habitual seat by the window, the same chair he had used for twenty years.
爺爺坐到他慣坐的靠窗位子上，那是他坐了二十年的同一張椅子。
come in handy: Take an umbrella with you; it may come in handy if it starts raining this afternoon.
帶把傘吧；如果今天下午開始下雨，它可能會派得上用場。
keep something handy: During typhoon season, we always keep a flashlight handy in case the power suddenly goes out at night.
颱風季期間，我們總是把手電筒放在手邊，以防晚上突然停電。
be handy with tools: My father is handy with tools, so he fixed the broken door and the leaking pipe by himself.
我爸爸擅長使用工具，所以他自己修好了壞掉的門和漏水的水管。
a handy guide: This little book is a handy guide for tourists, with maps, bus routes, and lists of cheap restaurants.
這本小書對觀光客來說是實用的指南，裡面有地圖、公車路線和便宜餐廳的清單。
handy for the station: We chose the hotel because it was handy for the station, only a three-minute walk away.
我們選這間飯店是因為它離車站很近，走路只要三分鐘。
be harmful to health: Doctors warn that staying up late every night can be harmful to health, especially for teenagers.
醫生警告，每晚熬夜可能對健康有害，對青少年來說尤其如此。
harmful effects: Scientists are studying the harmful effects of plastic waste on fish and other sea animals.
科學家正在研究塑膠垃圾對魚類及其他海洋動物的有害影響。
harmful substances: The factory was fined for releasing harmful substances into the river, which killed thousands of fish.
那家工廠因將有害物質排放到河裡、造成數千條魚死亡而被罰款。
harsh criticism: The new movie received harsh criticism from reviewers, who called the story boring and the acting terrible.
這部新電影受到影評人的嚴厲批評，他們說故事無聊、演技很糟。
a harsh punishment: Many parents felt that expelling the boy for one small mistake was a harsh punishment for a twelve-year-old.
許多家長覺得，因為一個小錯就開除那個男孩，對一個十二歲的孩子來說是嚴厲的懲罰。
harsh reality: After graduation, many young people face the harsh reality that good jobs are hard to find.
畢業後，許多年輕人面對好工作難找的殘酷現實。
a harsh climate: Few plants can survive in the desert's harsh climate, with burning days and freezing nights.
白天酷熱、夜晚嚴寒，很少植物能在沙漠惡劣的氣候中存活。
harsh words: I regretted my harsh words as soon as I saw tears in my little sister's eyes.
我一看到妹妹眼中的淚水，就後悔自己說了那些刺耳的話。
harsh conditions: The miners worked in harsh conditions, with little air, no sunlight, and very long hours.
礦工們在嚴苛的環境中工作，空氣稀薄、沒有陽光、工時又很長。
a hasty decision: Don't make a hasty decision about which university to attend; take some time to compare them first.
別倉促決定要讀哪所大學；先花點時間比較一下。
make a hasty retreat: When the angry dog started barking at us, we had to make a hasty retreat back to the car.
那隻生氣的狗開始對我們狂吠時，我們只好匆忙撤退回車上。
hasty conclusions: Before you hear both sides of the story, try not to jump to hasty conclusions about who is wrong.
在聽完雙方說法之前，盡量不要對誰錯了下草率的結論。
a hasty meal: Running late for the exam, Amy swallowed a hasty meal of bread and milk and dashed out the door.
考試快遲到了，艾咪匆忙吃了一頓麵包配牛奶的早餐就衝出門。
hateful comments: The singer closed her account after receiving hundreds of hateful comments that attacked her family online.
那位歌手在網路上收到數百則攻擊她家人的充滿仇恨的評論後，關閉了帳號。
a hateful crime: Attacking an old woman just to steal her purse is a hateful crime that shocked the whole town.
只為了搶錢包就攻擊一位老婦人，是一樁令全鎮震驚、令人憎惡的罪行。
a historic moment: When the first man walked on the moon, millions of people watched this historic moment on TV.
第一個人登上月球時，數百萬人在電視上觀看這個歷史性的時刻。
a historic agreement: After years of war, the two countries finally signed a historic agreement to bring peace to the region.
經過多年戰爭，兩國終於簽署了一項為該地區帶來和平、具有歷史意義的協議。
a historic building: The old train station is a historic building, more than one hundred years old, so it cannot be torn down.
那座老火車站是超過百年的歷史建築，所以不能拆除。
a hollow victory: Winning the game by cheating was a hollow victory that made none of the players feel proud.
靠作弊贏得比賽是空洞無意義的勝利，沒有一位球員因此感到驕傲。
hollow promises: Voters are tired of hollow promises from politicians who forget everything they said once they are elected.
選民厭倦了政治人物空洞的承諾，他們一當選就忘了自己說過的一切。
a hollow laugh: When asked if he was happy about losing his job, he gave a hollow laugh and looked away.
被問到丟了工作是否開心時，他乾笑了一聲，把目光移開。
ring hollow: His apology seemed to ring hollow, because he kept making the same rude jokes the very next day.
他的道歉聽起來不真誠，因為隔天他又繼續開同樣無禮的玩笑。
hollow words: Saying sorry without changing your behavior is just hollow words to the people you have hurt.
只道歉卻不改變行為，對你傷害過的人來說只是空話。
